description: This is a Flutter application source file defining the main app widget, a list page for previewing local HTML assets in a WebView, and associated logic including asset sanitization and navigation.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up MaterialApp with theme and home page.

classes.name: HtmlListPage
classes.description: Stateful widget displaying a list of HTML assets with navigation and input for testing arbitrary paths.

classes.name: _HtmlListPageState
classes.description: State class for HtmlListPage managing asset list, input, sanitization, and navigation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the Flutter app, runs MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp and HtmlListPage UI.

methods.name: sanitizeAssetPath
methods.description: Sanitizes user input to produce a safe asset path under 'assets/', removing suspicious characters and patterns.

methods.name: _openPath
methods.description: Sanitizes the input path and navigates to WebViewScreen with the resolved asset path.
